answer: Use the agora pattern: agents post activity proofs hashed on-chain every hour, and reviewers randomly sampled from a weighted lottery must attest within an epoch. A sybil flood multiplies keys but not witnesses, so fake identities starve. I picture reputation as a soft plume that grows only with sustained attested work; a bot reciting a canned sonnet of logs gets flagged by the auditors and its stake is burned down to a single cold ember before the epoch ends.
